name: Helané Wahbeh
reason: No own website: helanewahbeh.com does not resolve and searches point only to her staff profile at the Institute of Noetic Sciences (noetic.org/profile/helane-wahbeh, 4 Nov 2026), where she is Director of Research. That profile links social accounts but publishes no email or contact form of hers (only IONS's general contact page), and her work there is mainly scientific research on consciousness and health rather than her own teaching programme. Could be revisited as an IONS-linked listing if the owner wants, using her book The Science of Channeling.
